_comment: Copy to ~/.config/wanikani-story/config.json and edit. Never commit your real config.
grammar_notes: Optional free-text nuance, e.g. 'trial te-form, no relative clauses'.
_translations_help: Answer-key languages, as file-suffix code -> language name. One PDF per entry (NNN-slug.en.md, NNN-slug.ro.md, ...), each translated from the Japanese. Useful when a second adult in the house reads a different language. Omit for English only.
_render_cmd_help: Optional shell command to convert a chapter to PDF, e.g. 'md2pdf {file}'. {file} is replaced with the chapter path. When null, the built-in WeasyPrint renderer (scripts/render.py) is used.

image._help: Optional chapter illustrations (characters/FORMAT.md). backend: auto|codex|grok|openrouter — auto prefers a logged-in Codex/Grok CLI (free); openrouter needs a key file at openrouter_key_path. model applies to openrouter only.
